dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer! Well, this is a surprise. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Heh, the no{RUBY#[D]spies from Snezhnaya}rth wind has stilled — I was just going out for a little walk. With weather this nice, it wouldn't hurt to relax a l{RUBY#[D]ease up on security}ittle every now and then, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: You're right, it is a fine day. It's just that the shipment of b{RUBY#[D]Kanjou Commission intel}ird-pattern brocade we ordered from Inazuma still hasn't come in. We merchants really do have to stay on top of these things, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Quite the effort you've all put in. In that case, once the brocade arrives, I would appreciate it if you could set a piece aside for me as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Of course, Lady Nefer. Enjoy your walk.
